spans.s: --a king who ruled for १३ years. Br. III. ७४. १८७.

(II)--in Kali age; personal charm in the possession of hair; deserts her husband for power; a wealthy man, con- sidered as husband; fickle, short of stature, and gluttonous, speaks lies, is indecent and immoral; child bearing at the age of 5 or 6;
1: Vi. VI. १७-18, २८-31, ४१.
by honouring her husband she is elevated.
